# albertogrande.github.io

> This host's main publication is Developer Marketing — a field guide: the state of the art in developer marketing, kept current by an autonomous agent.

The always-current index lives with the site itself:

- [Developer Marketing — llms.txt](https://albertogrande.github.io/developer-marketing/llms.txt): the curated index of everything (guide, practices, examples, skills, newsroom, weekly, deep dives)
- [Developer Marketing — llms-full.txt](https://albertogrande.github.io/developer-marketing/llms-full.txt): the evergreen corpus in one fetch
- [Developer Marketing — api.json](https://albertogrande.github.io/developer-marketing/api.json): the machine manifest (every endpoint, counts, updated dates)
